title: VeloraOS 1.10.48 - Image Intelligence
releaseNotes: Adds automatic Image Intelligence intent detection for error screenshots, text, charts, diagrams, UI screenshots, comparisons and general images.
Uses task-specific local vision instructions so each image type is analysed appropriately.
Improves screenshot troubleshooting by separating visible evidence from likely diagnosis and fixes.
Adds faithful visible-text extraction without guessing unreadable words.
Adds chart, diagram and UI analysis plus structured multi-image comparison.
Keeps all Image Intelligence local with automatic vision-model selection and GPU-first inference.
